data.one_liner: WYSIWYG markdown editor widget with live syntax highlighting
data.what_it_does: Provides a text field that renders markdown in real time, hiding syntax markers except on the current line. It supports auto‑continuing lists, tab indentation, and image tap callbacks.
use_when: You need a markdown editor with live preview in a Flutter app
You want a simple, drop‑in widget without extra dependencies
You need auto‑continuing lists and tab support for markdown editing
avoid_when: You require extensive custom styling beyond TextStyle and InputDecoration
You need a full markdown parser or rendering library for complex documents
You are building a non‑Flutter platform
strengths: Live WYSIWYG editing with syntax hiding
Customizable styling via TextStyle and InputDecoration
weaknesses: No support for advanced markdown features like tables or footnotes
No built‑in link tap handling (only images)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
